title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E7 — Fuzz Lady
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E6 — The Heart of Rock 'n' Roll
Rock star Rick James (as himself) calls on the team when he discovers that inmates are threatening his imprisoned buddy (Isaac Hayes).

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E7 — Body Slam
Wrestler Hulk Hogan calls on old Vietnam buddy B.A. when mobsters threaten to close a friend's youth center.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E8 — Blood, Sweat and Cheers
B.A. drives in a stock car race to prevent Hannibal's nephew (Ken Olandt) being run off the track by thugs; guest Stuart Whitman.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E9 — Mind Games
Pardoned Face's book-promotion TV tour hits a snag when a Viet Cong general seeks revenge for his jilted daughter.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E10 — There Goes the Neighborhood
The team conceals in suburbia a rock singer threatened by terrorists, until a nosy neighbor blows the whistle.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E11 — The Doctor Is Out
The team journeys to a South American jungle to rescue Murdock's kidnapped therapist (Richard Anderson); guest Jeannetta Arnette.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E12 — Uncle Buckle-Up
The mob forces a children's TV-show host (Arte Johnson) to endorse cheap, unsafe Uncle Buckle-Up dolls.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E13 — Wheel of Fortune
Agents detour Murdock to South America when he embarks on a Hawaiian trip he won on "Wheel of Fortune"; guests Pat Sajak, Vanna White.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E14 — The A-Team Is Coming, The A-Team Is Coming
The team works with the Soviets to prevent an insane Soviet general from triggering World War III; guest William Smith.
